title: AWS API MCP Server operation normalization bypasses custom deny and consent rules
summary: Operation names containing consecutive capital letters fail to match correctly written denyList or elicitList entries, allowing operations the operator intended to block or gate.

severity.rationale: An assistant can perform cloud actions beyond the configured custom policy, including sensitive identity or destructive operations. User interaction and a custom policy are prerequisites; the impact warrants 72 hours.

exposure: Requires a locally run server with a custom policy covering affected operation names and user interaction with the assistant. The remote offering and READ_OPERATIONS_ONLY and REQUIRE_MUTATION_CONSENT settings are unaffected.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Upgrade awslabs.aws-api-mcp-server to 1.5.1 or later and patch derivative code. AWS lists no workaround other than upgrading.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updating and restarting can interrupt dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the installed version and the component used by running processes meet the documented fix or containment condition.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
